price_basis: Constant 2026 EUR planning cash costs, including retail VAT; procurement VAT recovery, inflation, financing, and tax-transfer corrections are not modelled.
scope: One camera/edge unit per existing signalized crossing, connected through an approved existing controller interface. Not a quotation, certified design, or new signal installation.

bom.name: Arduino UNO Q 4GB
bom.notes: EU retail price including VAT. 2GB alternative is EUR59.90; default selects 4GB headroom.

bom.name: Logitech C920s UVC camera
bom.notes: EU list price, not current sale price or confirmed Italian checkout. Indoor prototype camera; outdoor housing and optical suitability require validation.

bom.name: Anker 341 powered USB-C PD hub
bom.notes: Retail EUR listing. 85W pass-through maximum is not system power consumption; UNO Q compatibility must be bench-tested.

bom.name: Arduino USB-C Power Supply 45W
bom.notes: VAT included; 45W supply rating is not continuous demand. Board requires PD-compatible 5V/3A supply.

bom.name: Arduino USB-C 24-pin cable
bom.notes: 1m cable, VAT included. Additional outdoor-rated cable is budgeted separately.

installation.name: Approved existing-controller integration allowance
installation.notes: No direct Arduino lamp switching. Supplier-approved fail-safe interface, installation approval, and controller access required.

cost_build_up.notes: Ranges are editable planning scenarios, not confidence intervals or contractor quotes. Maintenance excludes separately calculated electricity. Offline operation assumes no WAN subscription. Platform allowance is not a vendor selling price or certification quotation. New poles, signals, trenching, mains supply, major controller upgrades, permits, central hosting, additional cameras, and product certification may require substantial extra cost.

annual_maintenance_eur.notes: Production reference: 2h labour at EUR60/h. Major replacement is budgeted separately; the old EUR60 annual replacement reserve has been removed to avoid counting replacements twice. Not measured service cost.

power_watts.notes: Continuous total edge/camera/hub/supply demand not measured; excludes existing signal lamp demand. 8W gives 70.08kWh/year.

electricity_eur_kwh.notes: Illustrative municipal marginal tariff, not ARERA household tariff or a Turin procurement quote.

grid_kg_kwh.notes: Piemonte regional consumption factor, including losses/import allocation, not marginal grid dispatch or lifecycle CO2e.

fuel_eur_l.notes: 2026-10-10 Piemonte self-service prices weighted by 2025 Turin petrol/diesel car stock including hybrids. Tax-inclusive user outlay, not net-tax resource cost. Gas fuels are excluded.

idle_lph.notes: Default 0.62 L/h is a rounded compact-car no-load reference, not a measured current Turin fleet mean. Argonne/ORNL examples convert to 0.606 L/h for 2L petrol, 0.644 L/h for 2L diesel, and 1.476 L/h for 4.6L petrol, without load. Larger cars and accessory loads can exceed this default. Start-stop/hybrid engine-off time is discounted separately; moving fuel consumption, air conditioning, warmup and restart fuel are not resolved.

combustion_kg_l.notes: EPA petrol/diesel combustion factors converted using 3.785411784 litres/US gallon then weighted by liquid-fuel Turin passenger-car stock. Not Italy-specific fuel composition or lifecycle CO2e.

ice_fraction.label: Petrol/diesel modelled share
ice_fraction.notes: 0.85249 covers petrol, diesel and their hybrids only. LPG/CNG/EV/unknown vehicles have zero modelled idle-fuel benefit. Stock mix is not observed crossing flow mix; hybrid engine switching is approximated separately.

engine_running_fraction.notes: Effective engine-on fraction accounts for start-stop and hybrid engine-off time; no local observations available.

vot_eur_h.notes: EUR10 is an editable current-money assumption, not an inflation-rebased official value. Handbook Italy urban car VOT in EUR2016 is 12.8 commuting/business and 5.9 personal. Pedestrian value is not separately measured.

carbon_eur_t.notes: Default 100 borrows the numeric handbook short/medium-term reference, originally EUR2016/tCO2e. Not rebased to 2026, not a carbon-credit price, not revenue. Range is a scenario range borrowing historical values, not a forecast confidence interval.

discount_rate.notes: EAV 2021 permits 3% in absence of national approach; editable planning convention, not financing cost.

horizon_years.notes: No measured system lifetime. Major replacements are separate from routine maintenance; default is 10% cumulative replacements spread over 10 years. No residual value assumed.

fleet_reference.geography: Torino province / metropolitan city, registered passenger cars
fleet_reference.notes: These are registered stock counts, not trips, road traffic, emissions, or unique crossing users. Gas-fuel categories excluded from the simplified idle fuel projection.

excluded_claims: No causal GDP increase is estimated. Time-value and productivity potential must not be added together as independent benefits.
No monetized accident reduction or legal certification claim is supported by simulator conflicts.
Fuel savings belong to road users, not municipal cash income. Carbon value is a social shadow value, not credit revenue.
This is a tax-inclusive planning appraisal, not a formal public-investment cost-benefit analysis net of tax transfers.
CO2 covers modelled engine-on idling and device electricity only: not embodied equipment, acceleration/restart, upstream fuel, routing changes, EV accessory power, NOx, PM, or full lifecycle CO2e.
